purpose: Reusable presentation/render frame for creative planning products and selected lane outputs.

visual_rules.frame: thin 35mm film-strip border on all four edges
visual_rules.accent_usage: red reserved for emphasis, status, hook or CTA cues
forbidden: film reel photo inside content area
director chair photo inside content area

render_rule: Visual frame is reusable. Lane output supplies content. Do not invent decorative visuals unless explicitly requested.
